exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with feet planted. Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width. Unrack and lower to mid-chest with control. Press up explosively. Keep shoulders retracted throughout.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand. Start with arms extended above chest. Lower with control until upper arms are parallel to floor. Press up, bringing dumbbells together at top.

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Set bench to 30-45 degree incline. Grip bar slightly wider than shoulders. Lower to upper chest, press up. Keep shoulder blades pinned to bench.

exercises.name: Push-Up
instructions: Start in plank position, hands slightly wider than shoulders. Lower body until chest nearly touches floor. Push back up. Keep core tight, body in straight line.

exercises.name: Dip
instructions: Support body on parallel bars with arms straight. Lean forward slightly. Lower until upper arms are parallel to floor. Press back up. Keep elbows tucked.

exercises.name: Cable Fly
instructions: Set cables at chest height. Step forward with slight bend in elbows. Bring hands together in front of chest in wide arc. Squeeze chest at peak contraction.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from bar with hands slightly wider than shoulders, palms facing away. Pull chest to bar. Lower with control. Avoid kipping.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
instructions: Hang from bar with hands shoulder-width, palms facing you. Pull chin over bar. Lower with control. Greater biceps involvement than pull-up.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge at hips, back flat, bar hanging at arm's length. Pull bar to lower ribs/upper abs. Squeeze shoulder blades together. Lower with control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
instructions: Support one knee and hand on bench. Pull dumbbell to hip, keeping elbow close to body. Squeeze lat at top. Lower with control.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit at machine, grip bar wide. Lean back slightly. Pull bar to upper chest. Squeeze lats. Return with control. Don't pull behind neck.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit with feet on platform, knees slightly bent. Pull handle to lower ribs. Squeeze shoulder blades together. Return with control, getting full stretch.

exercises.name: Face Pull
instructions: Set cable at face height with rope attachment. Pull rope toward face, separating hands. Squeeze rear delts and external rotators. Great for shoulder health.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
instructions: Stand with bar at shoulder level, hands just outside shoulders. Press overhead until arms locked out. Head moves through 'window' at top. Lower to shoulders.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Overhead Press
instructions: Stand or sit with dumbbells at shoulder height. Press overhead. Can use neutral grip (palms facing) for shoulder comfort.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at sides. Raise arms out to sides until parallel to floor. Slight bend in elbows. Lead with elbows, not hands. Control the negative.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly (Bent-Over Dumbbell)
instructions: Hinge at hips, chest toward floor. Raise dumbbells out to sides, squeezing rear delts. Keep slight bend in elbows. Don't shrug traps.

exercises.name: Pike Push-Up
instructions: Start in downward dog position. Lower head toward floor between hands. Push back up. Progress to handstand push-up.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand with barbell, supinated grip. Curl bar to shoulders. Keep elbows pinned to sides. Don't swing. Lower with control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at sides, palms forward. Curl to shoulders. Can alternate or do both together. Supinate at top for peak contraction.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at sides, neutral grip (palms facing). Curl to shoulders. Targets brachialis and brachioradialis.

exercises.name: Tricep Dip
instructions: Support body on parallel bars or bench. Keep torso upright. Lower until upper arms parallel to floor. Press up. Elbows back, not flared.

exercises.name: Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands. Lower behind head by bending elbows. Extend back up. Keep upper arms stationary.

exercises.name: Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Stand at cable with rope or straight bar. Keep elbows pinned to sides. Push down until arms straight. Squeeze triceps. Control the negative.

exercises.name: Back Squat
instructions: Bar on upper traps. Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out. Brace core, sit back and down. Drive through heels to stand. Hit parallel or below.

exercises.name: Front Squat
instructions: Bar on front delts, elbows high. Sit down and back. More upright torso than back squat. Greater quad emphasis.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold dumbbell at chest, elbows down. Squat between legs. Elbows track inside knees. Great for learning squat pattern.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Rear foot elevated on bench. Front foot forward. Lower until back knee near floor. Drive through front heel. Unilateral quad/glute builder.

exercises.name: Lunge
instructions: Step forward, lower until both knees at 90°. Front knee over ankle. Push back to start. Alternate legs or do all reps one side.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Bar at hip level, slight knee bend. Hinge at hips, push butt back. Lower until stretch in hamstrings. Squeeze glutes to return. Back flat throughout.

exercises.name: Deadlift
instructions: Bar over mid-foot. Hinge down, grip bar. Pull slack out. Drive floor away, extend hips and knees together. Bar stays close to body.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
instructions: Upper back on bench, bar on hips. Drive through heels, squeeze glutes at top. Chin tucked. Don't hyperextend lower back.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on back, knees bent, feet flat. Drive through heels, squeeze glutes at top. Hold briefly. Progress to single-leg or weighted.

exercises.name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit in machine, feet shoulder-width on platform. Lower until knees at 90°. Press through heels. Don't lock out knees at top.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
instructions: Sit with pad on shins. Extend knees fully. Squeeze quads at top. Control the negative. Good for isolation/volume.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
instructions: Lie/seat with pad on heels. Curl heels toward glutes. Squeeze hamstrings. Control the negative. Seated or lying variations.

exercises.name: Calf Raise
instructions: Balls of feet on platform, heels hanging. Lower heels for stretch. Raise up onto toes. Squeeze at top. Straight and bent knee versions.

exercises.name: Plank
instructions: Forearms on floor, body in straight line. Brace core, squeeze glutes. Don't let hips sag or pike. Breathe normally.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from bar. Raise legs to parallel (or higher). Control the negative. Don't swing. Can do knee raises as regression.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Kneel with ab wheel. Roll forward, extending arms. Keep core braced, back flat. Pull back with abs. Don't let hips sag.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit, lean back slightly, feet off floor. Rotate torso side to side. Touch floor each side. Can hold weight for progression.

exercises.name: Farmer's Walk
instructions: Hold heavy dumbbells at sides. Walk with tall posture. Shoulders back, core braced. Great for grip, traps, and full-body stability.

exercises.name: Shrug
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides. Shrug shoulders straight up toward ears. Squeeze at top. Don't roll shoulders. Heavy loads work well.

exercises.name: Wrist Curl
instructions: Forearms on bench, wrists hanging off. Curl wrist up (palms up) or down (palms down). Full range of motion. High reps.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Hinge at hips, swing KB between legs. Drive hips forward, swing to chest height. Arms just guide. Explosive hip hinge.

exercises.name: Turkish Get-Up
instructions: Lie down, KB pressed up. Roll to elbow, then hand. Bridge hips, sweep leg through. Stand up. Reverse. Complex but high carryover.

exercises.name: Battle Rope Waves
instructions: Anchor rope. Alternate arms creating waves. Keep core tight. High-intensity conditioning. Can do double waves, slams, circles.

exercises.name: Sled Push
instructions: Load sled. Hands on posts, arms straight. Drive legs, push forward. Low position = more quad. High = more glute. Great finisher.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
instructions: Hold band at shoulder width. Pull apart, squeezing shoulder blades. Great warm-up/prehab. High reps (15-20+).

exercises.name: Plate Pinch
instructions: Pinch two plates together smooth-side out. Hold for time. Builds pinch grip strength. Can do farmer's walk with pinch.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly (Machine)
instructions: Sit facing the pad on a reverse pec-deck machine, chest against the pad. Grip the handles with a slight bend in the elbows. Sweep arms out and back, squeezing rear delts and shoulder blades together. Return with control; don't let the weight stack slam.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly (Incline Bench)
instructions: Lie face-down on an incline bench set to 30-45 degrees, a dumbbell in each hand hanging straight down. Keeping a slight bend in the elbows, raise the dumbbells out to the sides until arms are roughly level with the torso, squeezing rear delts at the top. Lower with control.

exercises.name: Neck Curl
instructions: Lie on back, head off end of bench, plate held against forehead. Curl neck up, chin to chest. Lower with control. Light weight, high reps.

exercises.name: Neck Extension
instructions: Lie face down, head off end of bench, plate held against back of head. Extend neck up. Lower with control. Light weight, high reps.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Sit at machine, pads on knees, balls of feet on platform. Lower heels for a stretch. Press up onto toes. Squeeze at top. Targets soleus more than standing variations.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise (Barbell)
instructions: Bar on upper traps as in a squat. Balls of feet on a raised platform, heels hanging. Lower heels for a stretch, then rise onto toes. Squeeze at the top.

exercises.name: T-Bar Row
instructions: Straddle the bar, chest against the pad if available. Hinge forward, grip the handles. Pull the bar to your torso, squeezing shoulder blades together. Lower with control.

exercises.name: Chest Press Machine
instructions: Sit with back against pad, handles at chest height. Press forward until arms are extended. Return with control, keeping tension on the chest.

exercises.name: Pec Deck Fly
instructions: Sit with back against pad, arms on the pads or gripping handles at chest height. Bring arms together in front of chest in an arc. Squeeze chest at peak contraction. Return with control.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl
instructions: Rest upper arms on a preacher bench pad, bar hanging at arm's length. Curl the bar toward shoulders. Lower with control, stopping just short of full lockout to keep tension.

exercises.name: Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench, elbow braced against inner thigh, dumbbell hanging. Curl the weight to the shoulder, squeezing the bicep. Lower with control. One arm at a time.

exercises.name: Skull Crusher
instructions: Lie on a bench, bar held over chest with straight arms. Keeping upper arms stationary, lower the bar toward the forehead by bending elbows. Extend back up.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Grip the bar shoulder-width or slightly narrower. Lower to the lower chest, keeping elbows tucked close to the body. Press back up, emphasizing the triceps.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
instructions: Back and shoulders against the pads, feet shoulder-width on the platform. Lower until knees reach roughly 90 degrees. Press through heels to stand. Don't lock out knees hard at the top.

exercises.name: Step-Up
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides. Step onto a bench or box with one foot, drive through the heel to stand fully on top. Step back down with control. Alternate legs.

exercises.name: Good Morning
instructions: Bar on upper traps as in a squat. Keeping a slight knee bend and flat back, hinge forward at the hips until torso is near parallel to the floor. Drive hips forward to stand back up.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Wide stance, toes turned out, bar over mid-foot. Grip inside the knees. Chest up, drive through the floor and extend hips and knees together. More upright torso and greater quad/adductor involvement than a conventional pull.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Kneel below a high cable with a rope attachment, hands by the head. Crunch down, rounding the spine and bringing elbows toward knees. Squeeze abs. Return with control.

exercises.name: Side Plank
instructions: Lie on your side, forearm on the floor under the shoulder. Lift hips until body forms a straight line. Hold, keeping hips high and core braced. Switch sides.

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
instructions: Start in a high plank. Drive one knee toward the chest, then quickly switch legs in a running motion. Keep hips low and core braced throughout.

exercises.name: Landmine Press
instructions: One end of a barbell anchored in a landmine attachment (or a corner). Hold the other end at shoulder height with one hand. Press up and slightly forward along the natural arc. Lower with control.

exercises.name: Arnold Press
instructions: Start seated with dumbbells in front of shoulders, palms facing you. Press up while rotating palms to face forward. Reverse the rotation on the way down.

exercises.name: Upright Row
instructions: Hold a bar with a shoulder-width overhand grip in front of thighs. Pull straight up along the body, leading with elbows, to about chest height. Lower with control.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand side-on to a low cable pulley, handle in the far hand. Raise the arm out to the side until parallel to the floor, leading with the elbow. Lower with control. Constant tension throughout, unlike dumbbells.

exercises.name: Reverse Curl
instructions: Hold a bar with an overhand (palms-down) grip. Curl to the shoulders without rotating the wrists. Lower with control. Targets brachialis and forearms more than a standard curl.

exercises.name: Zottman Curl
instructions: Curl dumbbells up with palms facing up, as in a standard curl. At the top, rotate palms to face down. Lower slowly in this reversed grip. Rotate back to palms-up at the bottom.

exercises.name: Back Extension
instructions: Hips on the pad of a hyperextension bench, ankles secured, torso hinged down. Raise torso until body forms a straight line. Avoid hyperextending at the top. Lower with control.

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through
instructions: Stand facing away from a low cable, rope between the legs. Hinge at the hips, letting the rope pull back between the knees. Drive hips forward to stand, squeezing glutes at the top.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.description: A dumbbell hip-hinge variation emphasizing the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides, soften the knees, and hinge at the hips. Lower the weights close to your legs until you feel a hamstring stretch. Drive the hips forward to stand, keeping the back neutral.

exercises.name: Cable Incline Fly
exercises.description: An incline cable fly variation emphasizing the upper chest.
instructions: Set the bench to a low incline between two low cable pulleys. With a slight bend in the elbows, bring the handles together above the upper chest. Squeeze the chest and return with control.

exercises.name: Cable Seated Chest Fly
exercises.description: A seated cable fly variation for controlled chest isolation.
instructions: Sit upright between the cable pulleys with the handles at chest height. Bring the handles together in a wide arc, squeeze the chest, and return slowly while keeping tension on the cables.

exercises.name: Cable Fly with Chest Supported
exercises.description: A chest-supported cable fly that minimizes body movement.
instructions: Set an incline bench between the cables and brace your chest against it. Bring the handles together with a slight elbow bend, squeeze the chest, and return with control.

exercises.name: Cable Standing Fly
exercises.description: A standing cable fly using a stable split stance.
instructions: Stand between the pulleys in a stable split stance. With a slight bend in the elbows, bring the handles together in front of the chest and return slowly.

exercises.name: Cable Lying Fly
exercises.description: A lying cable fly performed from a flat or inclined bench.
instructions: Lie on a bench between the low cable pulleys. Start with the handles above the chest, lower them in a wide arc, then bring them together while keeping tension on the chest.

exercises.name: Cable Low Fly
exercises.description: A low-to-high cable fly emphasizing the upper chest.
instructions: Set the pulleys low and raise the handles in an arc from hip level to upper-chest height. Keep a soft bend in the elbows and squeeze at the top.

exercises.name: Cable Middle Fly
exercises.description: A mid-height cable fly targeting the center of the chest.
instructions: Set the pulleys around mid-chest height. Stand centered, bring the handles together directly in front of the chest, and return under control.
